LLCV display upscaling

NVIDIA Image Scaling SDK 1.0.3
Copyright (c) 2022 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. MIT license.
https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/NVIDIAImageScaling
Pinned source: 35e13ba316c98eeecf16f37eae70ce88019911f6
See NIS-LICENSE.txt (source: nis/licence.txt).
LLCV builds only the SDR scaler variants. The HDR-specific LLCV sharpening
experiment has been removed; upstream SDK HDR code is retained unmodified.

Conservative Morphological Anti-Aliasing 2 (CMAA2)
Copyright (c) 2018 Intel Corporation. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/GameTechDev/CMAA2
Pinned source: 071c6b0857559f4e36f614362e6d2aab1b61938a
See CMAA2-LICENSE.txt (source: cmaa2/license.txt).
Upstream Microsoft color-packing helpers retain their attribution in CMAA2.hlsl.
LLCV changes: clamp single-sample image loads to signed image bounds;
allow disabling the collection optimization with a guarded define.
Host integration uses the official direct-processing path, High preset,
full-sized work buffers, linear-light edge blending, and SDR BT.709 transfers.
HDR bypasses this display-only filter and retains the viewer's HDR output.
Shaders are compiled and embedded at build time. No experimental comparison
kernels other than CMAA2 and NIS are included in the regular application.
